recipes.name: HSEvo
setup: Install the pinned requirements.txt and native task dependencies; provide explicitly allowed provider credentials.

profiles.description: Native heuristic evolution invokes problems/bpp_online/eval.py for training and the native validation pass.

evaluation.description: Native heuristic evolution invokes problems/bpp_online/eval.py for training and the native validation pass.

argument_help: Hydra overrides: max_fe=N pop_size=N init_pop_size=N timeout=N
Choose a native model via model=... (HSEvo) or llm_client.model=... (ReEvo/MCTS-AHD).
limitations: Native code rewrites problems/bpp_online/gpt.py; the recipe runs only in the isolated source workspace.
Native evaluator and validation scores remain separate native artifacts; no canonical Arena score is inferred.

argument_help: The pilot uses reviewed cfg overlays; native Hydra command line options remain native.
limitations: Native code rewrites problems/bpp_online/gpt.py; the recipe runs only in the isolated source workspace.
Native evaluator and validation scores remain separate native artifacts; no canonical Arena score is inferred.

Native max_fe is not a strict API-call cap; retries and a complete generation can overshoot. The admitted wall timeout remains authoritative. API sampling controls are recorded as unenforced by the Codex-native gateway.
